pages.text: $(thing)Artifact of the Darkness Path.$(br2)Worn in the hand or in the Curios «bracelet» slot: speed and strength are doubled, abilities regenerate twice as fast, and your skin colors are inverted.
pages.title: Phantom's Stigma

pages.text: Multiple stigmata work as one. If «eye» is disabled in Curios, the item is not rendered on the character, and skin colors are not inverted, but the effects remain.
